caption: Circus Maximus, Rome
composition: Vast grassy oval of the ancient chariot stadium below the Palatine · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The great grassy oval of the ancient stadium stretches away from the camera, its running track curving around the central green with the Palatine ruins rising along the right. Rows of umbrella pines line the left edge, and Rome's rooftops close the far distance under a cloudless blue sky. At 13:11 the light is hard midday sun, and the long shadows of the pines stripe the grass.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Circus Maximus under midday light
